simpleanimals.guide.page.1.title: Simple Animals
simpleanimals.guide.page.1: Five animals Vanilla does not have: the shy deer, the wild boar that defends its piglets,
simpleanimals.guide.page.2.title: Simple Animals
simpleanimals.guide.page.2: the hedgehog that hunts silverfish and rolls up in a flash,
simpleanimals.guide.page.3.title: Simple Animals
simpleanimals.guide.page.3: the rare sideways-walking crab and the zebra, whose cross with a horse is the infertile zorse.
simpleanimals.guide.page.4.title: Deer
simpleanimals.guide.page.4: A shy herd animal of forests and taiga with red and fallow coats; bucks carry antlers.
simpleanimals.guide.page.5.title: Deer
simpleanimals.guide.page.5: It flees from players who run or come near empty-handed, but not from players who sneak or hold wheat or a carrot. Drops leather and beef like a cow.
simpleanimals.guide.page.6.title: Wild boar
simpleanimals.guide.page.6: Neutral, like the polar bear: an adult attacks a player who comes too close to one of its piglets.
simpleanimals.guide.page.7.title: Wild boar
simpleanimals.guide.page.7: Without piglets it only rams when it is hurt, shoved aside, or a player stays within 3 blocks for 6 seconds (sneaking does not count).
simpleanimals.guide.page.8.title: Hedgehog
simpleanimals.guide.page.8: A small animal of forests and meadows that hunts silverfish within 8 blocks and rolls up when threatened, as the armadillo does, but much faster: 0.3 seconds instead of about 1 second.
simpleanimals.guide.page.9.title: Crab
simpleanimals.guide.page.9: A harmless beach animal with a red or sand shell and two big claws; it walks sideways. Rare: single animals on beaches and in mangrove swamps, by day only. Drops raw crab.
simpleanimals.guide.page.10.title: Zebra
simpleanimals.guide.page.10: A horse of the savanna with its own looks: classic black-and-white striped coat and a stiff mane. Everything else is the Vanilla horse: tame it by riding, saddle, horse armor, same stats, same food.
simpleanimals.guide.page.11.title: Zorse
simpleanimals.guide.page.11: Zebra x horse: a brown rideable horse with zebra stripes on legs and rump. Infertile like the mule: it never mates. No spawn egg and no natural spawn.
simpleanimals.guide.page.12.title: Spawning
simpleanimals.guide.page.12: All natural spawns are low next to Vanilla (sheep 12, pig 10, cow 8), only in daylight on grass (the crab on sand or mud) and never in caves; spawn eggs, spawners and breeding are not limited.
simpleanimals.guide.page.13.title: Commands
simpleanimals.guide.page.13: /simpleanimals config shows and changes every option of config/simpleanimals-server.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simpleanimals.guide.page.14.title: Commands
simpleanimals.guide.page.14: Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once. Permission level 2.
simpleanimals.guide.page.15.title: Settings
simpleanimals.guide.page.15: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
